title: 153 Moorefield Park, Newbridge, Co. Kildare
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this exceptional four-bedroom, two-bathroom semi-detached family home to the market, further enhanced by a spacious garage conversion. No. 153 Moorefield Park enjoys a prime position within the highly sought-after Moorefield Park development in Newbridge, Co. Kildare. This superb property offers bright, spacious and well-proportioned accommodation throughout and is presented in good condition, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, growing families and investors alike. The garage conversion provides valuable additional living space and offers excellent flexibility to suit a variety of needs, whether as a home office, playroom, second living area or additional bedroom. The property enjoys a quiet, family-friendly setting while remaining within easy reach of an excellent range of local amenities, including shops, schools and recreational facilities. Newbridge Train Station is approximately a 20-minute walk away, while Newbridge Town Centre and the M7 motorway is just 5 minutes away, providing convenient transport links to Dublin and beyond. Combining generous living accommodation, versatile additional space, a highly convenient location and the added benefit of vacant possession with no onward chain, No. 153 Moorefield Park represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire a quality home in one of Newbridge’s most desirable residential developments.

Extending to approximately 122 sq. m., this impressive four-bedroom family home offers bright, spacious and well-appointed accommodation throughout, together with excellent storage, ample parking and a versatile garage conversion. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with guest WC, a generous sitting room featuring an open fireplace, and a fully fitted kitchen/dining area ideally suited to modern family living and entertaining. There is also an additional storage area, while the professionally converted garage provides a highly versatile extra room with its own WC – perfect for use as a home office, playroom, second living room or additional family space. Upstairs, there are four well-proportioned bedrooms, complemented by new carpets and built-in wardrobes, along with a fully tiled family bathroom. To the rear, the property enjoys a sunny, low-maintenance garden, providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining, relaxation and family enjoyment. A block-built shed with electricity offers further useful storage or workspace. Additional features include a new gas boiler, new roof, high-quality flooring, ample parking and excellent storage throughout. The property is also offered with no onward chain, providing added convenience for prospective purchasers. Offering generous living accommodation and plenty of potential for a new owner to put their own stamp on it, this superb home represents an excellent opportunity for growing families seeking space, versatility and comfort.

For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers on 086 8225318 or 01 908 9300.
